items.html: Now, this new light of the name MA, which comes out from the forehead of AK, is the last of all; therefore it does not contain the aspect of breath, as does the third phase, nor the aspects of observation, like the points of the eyes — it contains only the aspect of illumination alone. This is what is mentioned in the Zohar, in the Idra Zuta: “In the forehead it is revealed,” etc., for there is only a revelation of illumination in it, and nothing more. This is also what is written in the Zohar in many places: “When it arose in will to create the world of Atzilut.” The meaning is that the forehead of the will of AK arose in its will to create the world of Atzilut, by means of the new light of MA that comes out from it, through which the whole of Atzilut is corrected. It follows that the meaning of “Re'uta” is the secret of the aforementioned forehead of the will, for the Aramaic translation of “will” is “re'uta.”
